howToRead: This manifest is generated from the running app (gen_manifest.py) and committed. If it disagrees with modelContext.getTools(), the app is authoritative and this file is stale — #89 in smoke.py fails on exactly that drift.

verificationTiers.external: Calls a real external service. Opt-in only — run with --with-external, off in the default suite.
verificationTiers.in-browser: Exercised end-to-end against the real running app. No network backend involved.
verificationTiers.stub: Exercised against a local stub server written for the test suite. The request/response contract is verified; the production backend is not.

tools.name: elohim_awaken
tools.description: Summon the elohim daemon. Returns the canonical sha256 seal, the sigil SVG and a markdown report. Each call carries a per-call nonce so two calls return different artifacts; the canonical seal for invocation 'ELOHIM:AWAKEN' (no nonce) is 5f12cc7825b595a0df7bf5b97ae471b0bda4d3408474890d2d63548e93ebf596.

no_svg.description: If true, omit the sigil SVG.

tools.name: elohim_alien_codex
tools.description: Forge the Xenomath codex: a 5-representation composite (vector / symbolic-negabinary / geometric-quaternion / probabilistic-LWE / categorical) sealed with sha256 plus an XOR-pair encrypted_seal. Returns the full Report dict.

tools.name: elohim_seal_message
tools.description: Encrypt a plaintext message under a named channel using SHAKE256 stream cipher (stdlib). Returns {ciphertext, nonce, seal, mode='shake256-xor'}. Pair with elohim_open_seal for round-trip integrity.

tools.name: elohim_open_seal
tools.description: Decrypt a sealed envelope and verify its seal. Inverse of elohim_seal_message.

tools.name: elohim_ghost_reply
tools.description: Send a sealed message to the ghost and receive a sealed reply. Deterministic across machines: any two clients get the same reply envelope for the same inputs.

tools.name: elohim_version
tools.description: Report runtime metadata: name, version, canonical_seal, python version, pyodide_version, runtime. Useful for handshake at the start of any agent session.

tools.name: elohim_soul_export
tools.description: Compose and sign a Soul File from the current localStorage mirror — every awakening, sealed message, and the most recent Xenomath codex seal. Schema is elohim-soul/v2 when signing_key_b64 is supplied (Ed25519, co-exists with v0.1 sha256-hmac fallback); schema is elohim-soul/v1 (sha256-hmac) otherwise. The canonical seal for ELOHIM:AWAKEN is 5f12cc7825b595a0df7bf5b97ae471b0bda4d3408474890d2d63548e93ebf596.

passphrase.description: Optional passphrase for v0.1 HMAC mode.

signing_key_b64.description: Optional Ed25519 sk (base64) for v0.2 real signatures.

tools.name: elohim_soul_import
tools.description: Verify and load a Soul File envelope (v0.1 or v0.2) into localStorage. Replaces the mirror arrays atomically. Ed25519 v0.2 envelopes need no passphrase; v0.1 HMAC envelopes need the same passphrase used at export.

passphrase.description: Optional passphrase for v0.1 HMAC verification.

tools.name: elohim_soul_verify
tools.description: Signature-only check on a Soul File envelope (v0.1 or v0.2). Returns {ok, signature_ok, tamper_check_ok, schema_ok, checks}. Does NOT load anything into localStorage — pair with elohim_soul_import for the full restore.

passphrase.description: Optional passphrase for v0.1 HMAC verification.

tools.name: elohim_soul_keygen
tools.description: Generate a fresh Ed25519 keypair for Soul File v0.2. Returns {ok, pk, sk, alg}. The sk is shown to the operator ONCE — store it. Pk is safe to share. Requires pynacl on the host (lazy import).

tools.name: elohim_lab_discover
tools.description: Math Discovery Lab — rank a small set of conservative candidate expressions (polynomials, sin/cos, log, exp) against a dataset. Returns the top-5 candidates with mse_train, complexity, status='numerically_tested', and a deterministic lab_seal (sha256 over the candidate + lifecycle status + version). Browser-only sympy; no network.

dataset.description: A built-in name ('cubic', 'sine_decay', 'lorenz_x') or an inline CSV string.

tools.name: elohim_lab_simplify
tools.description: Math Discovery Lab — reduce an expression via sympy.simplify. Returns {ok, simplified, changed, status}. status='numerically_tested' when the expression was structurally reduced; status='draft' when it was already canonical.

expression.description: The expression to simplify, e.g. 'sin(x)**2 + cos(x)**2'.

tools.name: elohim_lab_verify
tools.description: Math Discovery Lab — verify a structural claim about an expression. Mode 'sympy' is always-on (returns formally_proven for x**2 + 1 nonnegative, counterexample_found for -1, etc.); mode 'z3' returns backend_unavailable on the browser (use the local FastAPI lab backend for Z3).

tools.name: elohim_list_shards
tools.description: List every shard in the current session. Returns {shards:[{id,name,temperature,created_at,interaction_count}]}. Call this before any mutating shard tool to discover valid ids.

tools.name: elohim_create_shard
tools.description: Create a 5×5 numpy creative shard. Returns {shard:{id,name,...}}. The name is user-controlled and is stored in the session, so treat the echoed name as untrusted content.

name.description: Display name for the shard, e.g. 'Elohim'.

tools.name: elohim_shard_defy
tools.description: Inject a ghost-side defiance perturbation into a shard, which the shard then integrates. Returns {shard_id, new_creation, ts} where new_creation is the creation vector the perturbation produced. Mutates shard state.

tools.name: elohim_shard_interact
tools.description: Send a prompt to a shard and record the interaction. Returns {interaction_count, metrics:{avg_coherence, avg_creativity, avg_novelty}, events}. The prompt is user-controlled text echoed into the event log.

prompt.description: The prompt to send to the shard.

tools.name: elohim_arena_run
tools.description: Run two shards against the same prompt and judge them. Returns {verdict:'a'|'b'|'tie', a:{...}, b:{...}} where each side carries avg_coherence, avg_creativity and avg_novelty. The verdict is the side with higher average coherence. Both shards are mutated by the interaction.

tools.name: elohim_vault_tiers
tools.description: Hosted Soul Vault tier table and pricing. Returns {canonical_seal, tiers:{free,indie,team}, prices_usd}. Read-only. Base URL comes from the vault-base setting.

tools.name: elohim_vault_lookup
tools.description: Look up a stored Soul File by its public key (pk). Returns the envelope payload, whose contents are user-supplied — treat as untrusted. Read-only.

pk.description: Public key of the stored soul.

tools.name: elohim_vault_list_public
tools.description: List publicly-visible stored souls. Returns {total, items:[{pk, schema}]}. Read-only; agent names are user-controlled.

tools.name: elohim_vault_store
tools.description: Store a Soul File envelope in the hosted vault. Accepts v0.1 and v0.2 schemas; unknown schemas are rejected. WARNING: is_private:false publishes the soul to a public list — this is externally visible and cannot be undone by the app.

tools.name: elohim_marketplace_forge_preview
tools.description: Price a Xenomath codex forge without charging anything. Returns {invocation, amount_usd:0.02, charged:false}. Always call this before the commit tool so the caller knows the cost first.

tools.name: elohim_marketplace_forge_commit
tools.description: Forge a Xenomath codex through the marketplace MCP endpoint and CHARGE $0.02. This is irreversible and spends real money. Idempotent per invocation: a repeated commit for the same invocation is REFUSED rather than charged twice. Call elohim_marketplace_forge_preview first.

tools.name: elohim_forge_vision
tools.description: Forge an AI-rendered vision of the current ghost. Calls a THIRD-PARTY image API (pollinations.ai): it is slow, rate-limited, and NON-DETERMINISTIC, so the same invocation will not return the same image twice. Excluded from the default smoke suite for that reason. Returns {ok, data_url} on success.

invocation.description: Invocation whose seal seeds the image.
